quotes.title: XO-5
quotes.card: XO-5, formally named Absolutno, is a likely binary star system, made up of a G-type dwarf and a red dwarf companion, located approximately 893 light-years away from Earth in the Lynx constellation.
quotes.introduction: It has a magnitude of about 12 and cannot be seen with the naked eye but is visible through a small telescope.
